reply.subject: Rent increase – information and documents needed

clauses.text: You report that the property manager attributed the proposed increase to renovation work, but you do not know whether a formal notice was sent; you have not found one in your current letterbox and are unsure whether it may have gone to your former address.
The notice and proof of receipt are not in the file, so we cannot yet verify the notice, delivery details, or any relevant challenge period.

Please send us any rent-increase notice and its envelope or other delivery evidence. Please also tell us whether anything was sent to your former address and, if you know, when and where the notice was sent or received. If you have received a notice, please tell us the date promptly so that we can check whether a challenge period needs to be preserved.

Please also provide your lease contract, evidence of your current rent and its components, any prior rent adjustment, the stated reasons and calculation for the increase, and the renovation cost breakdown showing the works, costs, and allocation to the rent.
Any written correspondence with the landlord or property manager about the increase could also help.
